description: TCS and Revanth announce a ₹70,000 crore AI data centre in Telangana, set for completion by June 2, 2028.
body_lead: Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy on Saturday announced ₹70,000-crore investment by the Tata Group, TCS and HyperVault in Telangana that would create the largest data centre in the country, creating direct and indirect employment to 7,000 people. The Chief Minister also set a deadline of June 2, 2028, the Telangana Formation Day, for the inauguration of what he described as India’s largest AI data centre. “From groundbreaking to inauguration, exactly 21 months from today, on June 2, 2028, we want to inaugurate India’s largest AI data centre,” he said.
